element.en: And according to Alvaro, these elements of production are not believed to be beneficial.
element.zh: 根据 Alvaro 的说法，这些生产要素被认为是没有益处的。

element.en: The reserve army would have arrested the supposedly “disloyal” elements within the Nazi party.
element.zh: 后备军本会逮捕纳粹党内所谓的“不忠”分子。

element.en: A game changer is a new element which, when introduced into a situation, completely changes it.
element.zh: game changer（改变游戏规则的事物）是一个新元素，当它被引入某种情况时，会彻底改变这种情况。

element.en: It’s saying that we need to decrease some elements of our production that are not beneficial.
element.zh: 它是说我们需要减少生产中那些无益的要素。

element.en: He writes. Does he apply that to like other elements of making a song though?
element.zh: 他写歌。但他会把这种劲头用到制作歌曲的其他环节吗？

elite.en: They were often recruited from Russian special forces or veterans of elite military units.
elite.zh: 他们通常从俄罗斯特种部队或精锐军事单位的退伍军人中招募。

elite.en: To many ordinary people, the old elite had lived above the law for decades.
elite.zh: 对许多普通人来说，老一代精英几十年来一直凌驾于法律之上。

elite.en: The very world, in other words, that Vance himself has described as a self-serving elite.
elite.zh: 换句话说，也就是 Vance 本人曾形容为自私自利的精英阶层。

elite.en: Once the Romans were surrounded on three sides, his elite African infantry attacked from the sides.
elite.zh: 一旦罗马人三面受敌，他精锐的非洲步兵便从两侧发起了合围。

elite.en: For the first time in history, higher education was no longer the preserve of a tiny elite.
elite.zh: 这是历史上第一次，高等教育不再是一小撮精英的专属领地。

elsewhere.en: Instead of helping fix the school, Betsy DeVos paid to place the child elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 但Betsy DeVos没有去帮忙修缮学校，而是花钱把孩子安置到了别处。

elsewhere.en: So, zebras' stripes confuse insects, telling them to look elsewhere for food.
elsewhere.zh: 所以，斑马的条纹迷惑了昆虫，告诉它们去别处寻找食物。

elsewhere.en: You know the other cabinet officers go to wonderful locations around the world, Paris, London, Shanghai, and elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 你知道，其他内阁官员会去世界各地的好地方，巴黎、伦敦、上海等等。

elsewhere.en: McDonald’s weren’t as successful in Iceland as they’d been elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: McDonald’s 在冰岛并沢像在其他地方那样成功。

elsewhere.en: Warehouses stored goods before they were transported elsewhere.
elsewhere.zh: 仓库在货物被运往别处之前将其储存起来。

electric.en: If the learner made a mistake, the teacher would administer an electric shock.
electric.zh: 如果“学生”答错了，“教师”就要对其施加电击。

electric.en: And electric bikes are making cycling accessible to more people, including older people.
electric.zh: 电动自行车让更多人能够骑车，包括老年人。

electric.en: It was my first record. So that was the Cult Electric was my first rock record.
electric.zh: 那是我的第一张唱片。所以那是The Cult的《Electric》，是我的第一张摇滚唱片。

electric.en: Cobalt is the metal that is used in rechargeable batteries, including those that are in electric cars.
electric.zh: 钴是用于可充电电池的金属，包括电动汽车中的电池。

electric.en: The world’s growing demand for electric vehicles and rechargeable batteries has made cobalt and copper super valuable.
electric.zh: 世界对电动汽车和可充电电池不断增长的需求使得钴和铜变得超级宝贵。

elevate.en: This made him the perfect candidate for those looking to elevate someone they could control.
elevate.zh: 这使他成为那些希望提升一个可以由自己掌控的人的完美人选。

elevate.en: But if they are lying to elevate their status or their appearance or to live up to some expectation, that's the mistake.
elevate.zh: 但如果他们为了提升自己的地位或外表，或者为了迎合某种期望而撒谎，那就是错误。

elevate.en: Emails that are hostile in tone and language, or even cc'ing senior personnel in on the message in order to elevate an issue and put someone in their place.
elevate.zh: 语气和语言充满敌意的邮件，或者甚至在邮件中抄送高层人员来升级问题并给某人一点颜色看看。

elevate.en: But anyway, this specific paper of Baumol, it resolves a kind of an issue that I think a lot of people--general public type people--have with entrepreneurship, with elevating entrepreneurship.
elevate.zh: 不管怎样，鲍莫尔这篇具体的论文，解决了一个我认为很多人——普通大众——对企业家精神、对推崇企业家精神抱有的疑虑。

electronic.en: Turing worked on some of Britain’s earliest electronic computers, including the Manchester Mark 1.
electronic.zh: Turing 参与了英国最早的一些电子计算机的研发，其中包括 Manchester Mark 1。

electronic.en: Instead of carrying a physical book, you can store your entire library on a small electronic device.
electronic.zh: 你不再需要携带实体书，而是可以将整个图书馆储存在一个小型的电子设备上。

electronic.en: It's come a long way from the first electronic messages of 1844 which you mentioned in your question, Neil.
electronic.zh: 从你在问题中提到的 1844 年的第一条电子信息到现在，它已经走过了很长一段路，Neil。

electronic.en: No electronic computers existed and many mathematicians believed calculation was something only humans could really do.
electronic.zh: 当时根本不存在电子计算机，许多数学家坚信计算是只有人类才能真正完成的事情。

electronic.en: You mentioned MySpace as one of the earliest social media platforms, but the first electronic message was actually sent much earlier, in 1844, using a series of dots and dashes tapped out by hand on a telegraph wire.
electronic.zh: 你提到 MySpace 是最早的社交媒体平台之一，但第一条电子信息实际上发送得要早得多，是在 1844 年，通过在电报线上手工敲出一系列点和划来发送的。

election.en: So, what happened? Why has Keir Starmer resigned after such a convincing election victory?
election.zh: 那么，究竟发生了什么？为什么Keir Starmer在取得如此令人信服的大选胜利后会辞职呢？

election.en: OK then, let’s get right into it and talk about the next general election.
election.zh: 好了，让我们直接进入正题，聊聊接下来的大选。

election.en: One district voted 80% for the Republicans and 20% for the Democrats in the last election.
election.zh: 在最近的一次选举中，第一个选区有80%的人投给共和党，20%的人投给民主党。

election.en: It was the year of Brexit, the US presidential election, and intense political polarisation.
election.zh: 那一年发生了英国脱欧公投、美国总统大选，政治两极分化也异常激烈。

election.en: Labour has a large majority in Parliament and Britain is not holding an election.
election.zh: 工党在议会中拥有多数席位，而且英国目前没有举行大选。

elbow.en: This is so cool. And I get out of bed and I'm like, man, my elbows don't hurt.
elbow.zh: 这太酷了。我从床上起来，心想：天哪，我的手肘不疼。

elbow.en: From that tattoo you now try to cover up to betting your friend you could climb up a large tree, only to fall down and break your elbow, making mistakes and learning from them is all a part of growing up.
elbow.zh: 从你现在想方设法遮起来的纹身，到跟朋友打赌说自己能爬上一棵大树、结果摔下来摔断了手肘——犯错并从中吸取教训，本来就是成长的一部分。

elbow.en: I can't stand it. Mmm. OK. I don't have too many rules about eating, but I was always told growing up that you shouldn't have your elbows on the table and I never really understood why, but I always remember that one.
elbow.zh: 我受不了那个。嗯，好吧。我对吃饭没有太多规矩，但我从小就被告知不应该把手肘放在桌子上，我一直不太明白为什么，但我一直记得这一条。

electrical.en: The learner would be strapped into a chair with electrical wiring so they couldn't escape.
electrical.zh: “学生”会被绑在一张接有电线的椅子上，无法逃脱。

electrical.en: For example, countries around the world use different electrical plugs which would be better to standardise – but imagine the work involved!
electrical.zh: 例如，世界各国使用不同的插头，如果能标准化会更好——但想象一下这涉及的工作量有多大！

electrical.en: Once in the middle ear, the eardrum amplifies the sounds before transmitting them to tiny hairs in the inner ear, which then sends electrical signals to the brain.
electrical.zh: 一旦进入中耳，耳膜就会放大声音，然后将其传输到内耳的微小毛细胞，最后毛细胞向大脑发送电信号。

elephant.en: They lost thousands of men. The elephants struggled in the snow.
elephant.zh: 他们损失了数千人。大象在雪地里举步维艰。

elephant.en: Was it a) elephants, b) lions, or c) zebras?
elephant.zh: 是 a) 大象，b) 狮子，还是 c) 斑马？

elephant.en: Scipio outmanoeuvred him, used Roman discipline to resist the initial elephant charge, and then exploited gaps in the Carthaginian line.
elephant.zh: 西庇阿技高一筹，利用罗马军队的纪律抵挡住了最初的战象冲锋，随后成功切入了迦太基阵型的漏洞。

elephant.en: In 2022, five animals escaped from Sydney's Taronga Zoo in Australia, but were the escaped animals: a) elephants b) lions c) zebras Hmm.
elephant.zh: 2022年，有五只动物从澳大利亚悉尼的塔龙加动物园逃脱，这些逃跑的动物是：a) 大象 b) 狮子 c) 斑马 嗯。

electricity.en: The streets were redesigned, public parks were built, and electricity and street cars appeared.
electricity.zh: 街道被重新规划，公共公园建成，电力和有轨电车也出现了。

electricity.en: And the computers in the data centre, of course, also need energy; they need electricity.
electricity.zh: 当然，数据中心里的计算机也需要能量；它们需要电力。

electricity.en: Microsoft has signed a deal to buy fusion electricity from a company called Helion by 2028.
electricity.zh: Microsoft 已经签署了一项协议，到2028年从一家名为 Helion 的公司购买核聚变电力。

electricity.en: Cars, planes, factories, shipping, plastics, electricity production, all of these things depend on oil.
electricity.zh: 汽车、飞机、工厂、航运、塑料、电力生产，所有这些都依赖于石油。

electricity.en: Data centres in the United States now use more than 4% of the country's entire electricity supply.
electricity.zh: 美国的数据中心现在消耗了该国4%以上的总电力供应。

eliminate.en: Because usually like that, and what's interesting is like, you can define commitment by eliminating alternatives.
eliminate.zh: 因为通常像那样，有趣的是，你可以通过排除其他选项来定义承诺。

eliminate.en: Right? Like you can say I'm committed, but until you eliminate other options, you're not committed.
eliminate.zh: 对吧？你可以说我很坚定，但在你排除其他选择之前，你根本算不上坚定。

eliminate.en: Becoming fluent in English does not mean eliminating your native language.
eliminate.zh: 英语说得流利并不意味着要消灭你的母语。

eliminate.en: Ending poverty suggests eliminating it completely.
eliminate.zh: 根除贫困则意味着彻底消灭贫困。

eliminate.en: There was little advantage to be had in slaughtering your enemy and completely eliminating the threat, as is often the goal in modern combat scenarios.
eliminate.zh: 屠杀敌人并彻底消灭威胁并没有什么太大好处，正如这通常是现代作战场景中的目标一样。

electronics.en: Conditions on Venus mean that ordinary electronics simply won’t work.
electronics.zh: 金星上的环境意味着普通电子设备根本无法工作。

electrode.en: The electrodes were props. The shock generator was not connected to anything.
electrode.zh: 电极只是道具，电击发生器根本没有接通任何东西。

electrode.en: Electrodes were attached to his wrist. The door was closed.
electrode.zh: 电极被绑在他的手腕上，房门随即关闭。

electrode.en: I want meaning. And you're like, okay, well, I'll put an electrode in there and I'll give you meaning.
electrode.zh: 我想要意义。你会说，好吧，我会放一个电极进去，给你意义。

electrode.en: Not having the sense that anything is missing in this moment. needing something to change your current positive situation being contingent on an adjustment on getting something from the outside world ironically i think most people if you were to ask them when they were happiest for a sustained period of time not for a brief moment because pleasure can override happiness and create kind of this illusion of happiness but if you ask people when they were happy for a sustained period of time they were probably doing some variation of nothing that's interesting because in the chase is this sort of lack this contingency that's right but then you get bored if you just sit around all the time you get bored so you want adventure you want surprise like there's the funny thought experiment of the bliss machine right which is suppose i could drill a hole in your head and put an electrode in and they did this with monkeys and i can put a wire in there and i can stimulate just the right part of your brain and I can put you in bliss and you'll just be in bliss.
electrode.zh: 没有那种在这一刻缺少什么的感觉。不需要任何东西来改变你当前的积极状况，这种状况取决于调整，取决于从外部世界获得什么。讽刺的是，我认为大多数人，如果你问他们什么时候最快乐，在一段持续的时间里，而不是短暂的瞬间，因为快乐可以覆盖幸福并创造一种幸福的错觉，但如果你问人们什么时候在一段持续的时间里感到快乐，他们可能在做某种形式的“什么都不做”。这很有趣，因为在追求中存在这种缺乏，这种偶然性，没错。但如果你一直坐着，你会感到无聊，所以你想要冒险，你想要惊喜，就像那个关于“极乐机器”的有趣思想实验，对吧？假设我可以在你的头上钻个洞，放一个电极进去，他们对猴子做过这个，我可以在那里放一根电线，我可以刺激你大脑中正确的部分，我可以让你处于极乐状态，你就会一直处于极乐状态。

eligible.en: This is the visa a student is eligible for after they graduate from university.
eligible.zh: 这是学生从大学毕业后有资格获得的签证。

eligible.en: Fewer jobs are eligible for sponsorship, and you have to meet high salary thresholds.
eligible.zh: 有资格获得担保的工作变少了，而且你必须满足很高的薪资门槛。

eligible.en: Then, every eligible adult votes for the person they want in their constituency, in their geographical area.
eligible.zh: 然后，每个符合条件的成年人都会在他们所在的选区（即地理区域）投票给他们想要的人。

eligible.en: In a typical monarchy — like Britain, Spain, or the Netherlands — the crown passes downwards, from ruling male to the eldest next eligible male.
eligible.zh: 在一个典型的君主国——比如英国、西班牙或荷兰——王位是向下传递的，从执政的男性传给符合资格的下一个长子。

eligible.en: So, what happened? Well, the referendum, in the great tradition of Italian referendums, was declared void after only around 30% of the eligible population turned up to vote.
eligible.zh: 那么，结果如何呢？嗯，延续意大利公投的优良传统，在只有大约30%的有资格人口参与投票后，这次公投被宣布无效。

eloquent.en: It was disturbingly rational. Logical. Eloquent.
eloquent.zh: 它令人不安地理性。逻辑严密。文笔流畅。

eloquent.en: They shifted the focus away from purely preparing men for service in the church or the courtroom, and towards shaping a more rounded, critical, and eloquent citizen.
eloquent.zh: 他们的重点从纯粹为教会或法庭服务培养人才，转变为塑造一个更全面、更有批判精神、更有口才的公民。

elegant.en: The formulas that Ramanujan had sent were deep, elegant, and most importantly, new.
elegant.zh: Ramanujan寄去的公式深邃、优雅，最重要的是，它们是崭新的。

elegant.en: The population grew. Wealthy nobles built grand palaces and elegant residences in Warsaw.
elegant.zh: 人口增长了。富有的贵族们在华沙建造了宏伟的宫殿和优雅的宅邸。

elegant.en: It was a simple and elegant solution, and it brought order back to the Roman world.
elegant.zh: 这是一个简单而优雅的解决方案，它给罗马世界带回了秩序。

elegant.en: And that, like, I just feel like that's such an elegant way of thinking about it.
elegant.zh: 我觉得这是一种非常优雅的思考方式。

elegant.en: And they remind us that while the natural world may not be perfectly elegant, our ability to adapt and find solutions is something truly remarkable.
elegant.zh: 它们提醒我们，虽然自然界可能并不完全优雅，但我们适应和寻找解决方案的能力确实非常了不起。

elaborate.en: And if we look at the other end of society, British food was actually extremely elaborate.
elaborate.zh: 如果我们看看社会的另一端，英国食物实际上是非常精致复杂的。

elaborate.en: Aristocratic meals contained enormous quantities of meat, elaborate dishes, sugar, and imported spices.
elaborate.zh: 贵族的餐食包含大量的肉类、精致的菜肴、糖和进口香料。

elaborate.en: These massive structures were impressive and elaborate tombs, designed to protect the Pharaohs ‘, the Egyptian king’s, bodies and help their soul travel to the afterlife.
elaborate.zh: 这些宏伟的建筑是令人惊叹且复杂的陵墓，旨在保护法老（埃及国王）的遗体并帮助他们的灵魂前往来世。

elementary.en: So, I mean, there were so many great things going on at Burton Elementary.
elementary.zh: 所以，我的意思是，Burton小学当时有那么多棒极了的事情在发生。

elementary.en: It’s a very elementary school example, but hopefully you can all understand it.
elementary.zh: 这是一个非常小学的例子，但希望你们都能听懂。

elementary.en: I finally did reach someone who'd been at the public school Betsy DeVos volunteered at, Burton Elementary.
elementary.zh: 我最终联系到了一个曾与Betsy DeVos做过志愿者的公立学校——Burton Elementary共事过的人。

elementary.en: When he was a teenager, he received a book that changed his life, “A Synopsis of Elementary Results in Pure and Applied Mathematics” by George Carr.
elementary.zh: 在他十几岁时，他得到了一本改变他一生的书——乔治·卡尔（George Carr）的《纯粹与应用数学基本结果概要》。

elementary.en: These are different things. I used to work in Japanese junior high schools and elementary schools, and I can confidently say that none of the classes I worked in were learning English for the ability to use English in real life.
elementary.zh: 这是两码事。我过去曾在日本的初中和小学工作过，我可以自信地说，我工作过的班级没有一个是在为了在现实生活中使用英语的能力而学习英语。

elimination.en: It used logical elimination, rather than just guessing codes.
elimination.zh: 它运用的是逻辑排除法，而不仅仅是猜测密码。

elevator.en: The elevator had this big graffiti painting on it that was awesome.
elevator.zh: 电梯上有一幅很酷的大涂鸦画。
